> [!WARNING]
> This is a testing release and contains known regressions.

Following the recent Emu68 public API integration and fault-handler work,
some regressions were identified and have not yet been fully resolved.

The primary purpose of this pre-release is to validate the new release
pipeline and its recently integrated components, including:

- the new release image profiles;
- RTG integration and separate `VideoCore.card` artifacts;
- SD card board integration;
- single-core and multicore variants;
- automatic generation and publication of images and checksums.

This release is intended for testing and diagnostic collection. It should not
be considered stable or recommended for regular use.
